best_idea: A stamina pool whose refill ramps up while idle, restarts when you attack, pauses while you block, refunds a little on a hit, and refuses any action that would drive it below zero.
decision_why: The state-gated ramp and the spend gate are the stamina economy the guard and parry rules need; take the shape as is, fix the poise rate that is never reset, and keep the values as catalogue data.
acceptance: A player who keeps attacking sees stamina stop refilling; after about 2 s idle it refills faster and reaches full in about 15 s from empty; holding block stops the refill; an attack costing 10 at 8 stamina is refused with a not-enough-stamina cue; a stagger refills poise from a zero rate, not at the cap.
